opensen.name: OpenSen
opensen.tagline: Learn English through chunking — memorize whole phrases, not words.
opensen.description: Open Sentence is a language learning ecosystem that helps learners memorize English through the chunking method: memorizing whole sentences and pre-assembled phrases so they retrieve language automatically rather than constructing it word-by-word.
features: Dialog Builder — Generate memorization-ready dialogs and speeches
Chunk Library — High-frequency native phrases with swap patterns
Situation Coverage — Real-world scenarios (small talk, ordering, travel, etc.)
Practice Plan — Spaced repetition based practice schedules
Anki export — Take your chunks anywhere

yt-hunter.name: YT Hunter
yt-hunter.tagline: Save YouTube URLs and auto-fetch transcripts instantly.
yt-hunter.description: A small open-source tool with a mobile app and browser extension. Paste a YouTube URL and YT Hunter automatically saves the video and fetches the transcript via TranscriptAPI — stored locally with the video reference.
features: Browser extension for Chrome & Firefox — one-click save
Mobile app (Flutter / React Native) for on-the-go capture
Local storage with IndexedDB — your data stays yours
Optional sync backend for multi-device access

open-farm.name: Open Farm
open-farm.tagline: A decentralized identity and traceability layer for real farms on Sui. Every harvest carries the farmer, the story, and the proof.
open-farm.description: Open Farm is a real-world AgTech platform that uses Web3 as infrastructure — not as a game. It puts a verifiable on-chain identity and harvest record on every physical farm and every crop it produces, then lets consumers see that record by scanning a QR code. The product is a Sui Move stack (Farmer Passport, Season Log NFT), a Walrus-backed Harvest Story for tamper-evident media, an AI Copilot that signs its advisories on chain, and a public Consumer Trust Scan landing page. Built as a Devpost hackathon submission; the Web3 is intentionally invisible to normal shoppers.
open-farm.problem: Food has a trust gap. Shoppers cannot verify who grew what, where, or how. Farmers have no portable digital identity and no way to prove the quality and sustainability of a specific harvest. Climate change is making outcomes less predictable every season. Open Farm turns each harvest into a signed, queryable record so trust is grounded in evidence — not in marketing copy.
features: Farmer Passport — on-chain farmer identity with a trust score, sustainability certifications, and Green Points earned per verified season
Season Log NFT + Walrus Harvest Story — a milestone timeline (planting, watering, harvest, delivery) for every crop, with photos and notes pinned to Walrus so the record cannot be silently edited
AI Copilot with signed advisories — disease detection, weather, irrigation, and climate risk, with each recommendation signed on chain via AISignerCap and protected against replay
Consumer Trust Scan — a public QR landing page that anyone can open; no wallet required, with zkLogin available for buyers who want to leave feedback or follow the farm
Escrow-gated milestones — harvest evidence unlocks payouts progressively, so the on-chain record and the off-chain settlement stay aligned
Web3 stays invisible — sponsored transactions and zkLogin mean a normal shopper never has to think about a wallet, a seed phrase, or gas

techStack.label: How it's built
groups: Move packages on Sui — Farmer Passport, Season Log NFT, AI advisory signer, and escrow module (object-centric design, UpgradeCap-governed)
Storage — Walrus for tamper-evident harvest media and AI advisory payloads
Auth & onboarding — zkLogin for farmers and consumers, sponsored transactions so the chain stays out of the way
Frontend — Next.js, TailwindCSS, Framer Motion; a public read view for the QR scan flow
AI — image recognition for crop health and climate analytics; outputs are signed before being written on chain
Data layer — indexer and worker for farm events, provenance lookups, certifications, and AI advisory replays

whatsNext.label: What's next
items: Direct-market escrow so buyers can pay farmers against verified harvest milestones
Regional climate intelligence maps built on top of signed advisories
Export verification tool that reuses the Walrus-backed harvest record
Cooperative-level Green Points so small farms can pool sustainability reputation
Floor insurance primitive for farmers whose AI-flagged risk crosses a threshold
Open APIs for retailers and food safety auditors to query the on-chain provenance directly
